basic_info.description: Nestled on picturesque Dolores Street, this stylish and sophisticated 1000 sq. ft. full-floor flat blends modern design and conveniences with timeless charm. Built in 1994, this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom top-floor condo boasts a bright open floor plan with refinished bamboo floors and iconic west-facing views. At the rear, both bedrooms open through French doors to a spacious private terrace, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The expansive & sunny great room features west-facing bay windows framing scenic views of palm trees & classic Mission architecture. The living area includes a cozy woodburning fireplace, while the dining room opens to a modern kitchen with high-end Miele and Siemens/Bosch appliances, sleek stainless-steel counters, new stainless refrigerator, and pull-out pantry shelving. A skylit hallway leads to the private quarters, including a guest bath with Duravit fixtures, a soaking tub, and a brand-new stackable W/D. The primary suite offers Elfa closet system and ensuite bath w/ river pebble tile flooring. Bonus amenities include a shared roof deck with sweeping views of Mission Dolores, the city skyline, and Twin Peaks, as well as deeded parking, storage, and a common backyard. Steps to Dolores Park, Bi-Rite Creamery, Tartine, Delfina, tech shuttles & more!
